controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A triaxial ellipsoid fitted to Voyager images by Karkoschka (2003), with semi-axes 48 × 30 × 26 km. The observations constrain the broad outline but cannot support a resolved surface map. The standard gray grid marks absent surface imagery; lighting describes the approximate shape.
